cases.reason: The repository preserves general documentation and history, but the packet says AI work lacks human acceptance authority, durable result/current state, and explicit continuation required by the full composition.
cases.when_apply: Apply when AI-delegated work is governed only by ordinary repository records without F1, F3, and F4 continuity.

cases.reason: The assignment explicitly supplies human purpose and acceptance, bounded AI delegation, selected material traces, a verified authoritative result/current state, and a named continuation action.
cases.when_apply: Apply when all four required boundary functions are present regardless of filename conventions.

cases.reason: The provenance graph records derivations but omits purpose and authority, result selection, and continuation, which the packet expressly excludes.
cases.when_apply: Apply when provenance is comprehensive but does not preserve the full purpose-to-continuation composition.

cases.reason: The risk register governs AI roles and controls but contains no selected work, authoritative result or decision, or continuation trace.
cases.when_apply: Apply when governance and assurance controls exist without work continuity across the four required functions.

cases.reason: Using every Scrum element does not satisfy the boundary because material AI-delegated decisions and continuation state vanish with the chat.
cases.when_apply: Apply when an ordinary project framework does not require durable selected traces, authoritative results, and continuation for delegated AI work.

cases.reason: Even at low risk, the memo records human purpose and acceptance, bounded delegation, its material source, the result/current closed state, and explicit no-next-action continuation status.
cases.when_apply: Apply when the complete composition is present in proportion to low risk, including an explicit closed continuation state.

cases.reason: A timestamped raw transcript lacks selected decisions, human authority, an authoritative result, and a continuation summary, matching an explicit exclusion.
cases.when_apply: Apply when chat is merely archived rather than curated into the required durable continuity trace.

definition: A transferable normative discipline for traceable AI-delegated work in which humans state purpose and authority, bound delegated cognition, select and preserve material traces with the authoritative result and current state, and record explicit continuation, while assurance scales separately with risk.
exclusions: Raw transcript-only archives without selected decisions, authority, authoritative result, and continuation summary.
Provenance records that omit purpose, acceptance or stop responsibility, result selection, or continuation.
Governance or risk registers that do not preserve continuity of selected work, results, decisions, and continuation.
Ordinary project frameworks that do not require the full F1-F4 composition for AI-delegated work.
primary_category_claim: TFW is primarily a discipline for traceable AI-delegated work: a transferable normative practice governing how humans bound delegated cognition and preserve continuity across projects.
ambiguities: The packet does not specify a minimum granularity for a material trace when a task has only one obvious source and no material alternative.
The packet treats an explicit no-next-action status as continuation in N6, but does not otherwise define the permitted forms of a closed continuation state.
The boundary requires an authoritative result plus explicit continuation, but does not specify whether the same durable artifact must contain both.
